title: PRJ-2 — Projects Sub-Scope Customisation And Seed Delivery
summary: add Projects-only folder metadata and controls, project it into the local Manage manifest, and seed notes from current project folders
content_html:
PRJ-2 — Projects Sub-Scope Customisation And Seed Delivery

Status And Purpose

Proposed as PRJ-2 after the local-link contract in PRJ-1.

This delivery turns dotlineform/projects into a useful folder-notes collection. It adds one Manage-only registered customisation, one optional folder_path metadata field, and an explicit preview/apply seed from the current project-folder inventory.

Complete Outcome

Every Project document can store and edit one normalized Folder Link. The exact value is written to source front matter and projected into that document's namespaced row in local manage-manifest.json. The Projects report can show the link and offer its exact Open in Finder action while the shared default report and public manifest stay unchanged.

A one-time or repeatable preview/apply workflow can propose documents for current project folders that have no exact Project-document path match. Apply creates only the explicitly confirmed documents. It establishes a useful starting collection, not synchronization.

Fixed Design Notes

  • The configured collection selects a known projects customisation; no runtime branch infers behavior from scope, sub-scope, title, or filename.
  • folder_path is optional convenience metadata, not identity, validity, or a lifecycle condition.
  • folder_path belongs only to Project document source and the namespaced Docs Viewer Manage projection. PRJ-2 neither reads nor changes Studio Works and adds no Studio field, UI control, payload, hook, or service dependency.
  • Project-specific row data lives only in the customisation namespace of the local Manage manifest.
  • The ordinary/public manifest remains {doc_id, title} and imports no Manage customisation module.
  • Edit Metadata reads and writes the exact validated Project document.
  • Documents may be created with no path or with an in-root relative path that does not yet exist.
  • The path validity and activation root is $DOTLINEFORM_PROJECTS_BASE_DIR/; a Project document may deliberately represent a contained folder outside projects/.
  • Seed candidates come from the same confined current-folder inventory later consumed by Project State. Initial discovery is rooted at projects/, not the entire base directory. Candidate depth must be explicit in preview; nested working directories and unrelated base-root folders are never silently expanded into notes.
  • Seed matching uses normalized path evidence, never mutable document titles.
  • Existing, missing, duplicate, and prospective documents remain untouched unless they are exact confirmed mutation targets.

Delivery Discipline

PRJ-2 should remain one registered sub-scope customisation plus a thin seed adapter over existing metadata, manifest, document-creation, and report seams. It must not introduce another manifest format, generic registry, parallel document writer, folder synchronization service, or general bulk-workflow framework.

PRJ-2.0 must record the exact proposed files, reused owners, and rough production/test diff size. If the implementation materially exceeds the one field projector, exact-target controls, and preview/apply seed described here, pause for review and move the extra capability into a separately accepted delivery. Line count is a scope signal, not a reason to compress or duplicate code.

Rough Delivery Steps

PRJ-2.0 — Freeze Customisation And Seed Contracts

  • [ ] Trace current dotlineform/projects config, default report host, manifests, metadata schema/modal, document creation, and sub-scope customisation registries.
  • [ ] Freeze folder_path source validation, Manage-manifest row shape, browser descriptor, row/detail controls, and public exclusion.
  • [ ] Freeze current-folder candidate depth, proposed title, exact source target, base-root containment, deliberate non-projects/ links, duplicate detection, preview receipt, and committed follow-through behavior.
  • [ ] Record the exact file list, reused seams, rough production/test diff estimate, and any proposed expansion before implementation approval.

Checkpoint: one reviewed contract covers a manually created prospective document, a linked existing document, a duplicate link, and a seeded document.

PRJ-2.1 — Project Metadata And Projection

  • [ ] Register the Manage-only Projects Python and browser customisation pair.
  • [ ] Add exact-target folder_path read/write through the existing metadata owner and PRJ-1 normalizer.
  • [ ] Project only validated namespaced row data into manage-manifest.json.
  • [ ] Render Project-specific link state and exact Open in Finder without changing default membership or navigation.

PRJ-2.2 — Seed Preview And Apply

  • [ ] Add a write-free confined folder inventory and seed preview.
  • [ ] Report existing exact matches, missing documents, duplicate declared paths, source collisions, and proposed exact document identities.
  • [ ] Apply only the confirmed create-only set through the existing document creation and rebuild owners.
  • [ ] On post-commit presentation failure, retain committed targets and retry refresh/open only; never create again.

PRJ-2.3 — Verify Real Collection

  • [ ] Run focused config, projector, metadata, customisation registry, seed, exact-target, public-boundary, lint, and whitespace checks.
  • [ ] Preview the real roughly 200-folder inventory before any bulk apply and review representative odd names, spaces, duplicates, and missing paths.
  • [ ] After explicit acceptance, seed the collection and inspect its real default/list/detail behavior at realistic density.
  • [ ] Transfer the shipped extension contract to the durable sub-scope customisation architecture and retain Projects-specific product meaning in the Projects Concept.

Not In Scope

  • continuous folder/document synchronization;
  • automatic rename, merge, delete, or stale-link repair;
  • Work or Series reconciliation;
  • Project State report generation;
  • Resolver Tokens; or
  • public folder metadata.

Completion Evidence

  • Manual and seeded Project documents share the same front-matter and manifest contract.
  • Default and public sub-scope payloads remain byte-compatible and folder-blind.
  • The customisation uses exact document targets and handles missing/duplicate paths as visible states.
  • Seed preview is write-free, apply is create-only for the confirmed set, and committed failures cannot duplicate documents.
  • Real collection review distinguishes generated projection evidence from manual UI acceptance.
